recentItems.title: Ganesh Dust to Stardust - Official Trailer | Ganesh Acharya | Shivanshu Soni | 11th December 2026
recentItems.description:
Sapne har koi dekhta hai, lekin sach ussi ke hote hai jo mehnat karta hai..

#GaneshDustToStardust

Releasing in cinema near you on 11th December, 2026.

Presenting the official trailer of Ganesh Dust to Stardust, a film written and directed by Ganesh Acharya and produced by Soundaraya.
